findings.title: Guard every session operation after a failed reconnect
findings.description: After a reconnect fails, `unusable_reason` is set and methods such as `dispatch`, `compact`, and `seed_context` check it. `set_model` does not. The session dispatch path calls `set_model` before `dispatch`, so a later step can still send a control request to the failed client before the unusable-session error is raised. Check usability in `set_model` (and other public operations that can access the client) before making SDK calls.

findings.title: Reject non-positive background idle timeouts
findings.description: The new timeout config is only type-checked as an integer. `set_config` accepts values such as `-1`, and `asyncio.timeout` then expires immediately on the next wait while background agents are active, causing them to be stopped and returning a partial response. Validate that the configured timeout is positive and report an explicit configuration error instead.

findings.title: Add a load test for persistent-session background dispatch
findings.description: This change adds asynchronous SDK stream coordination, background-task stopping, and timeout behavior, but the existing tests exercise these paths only with scripted clients; there is no corresponding load test in `tests/load/`. The project’s Python rules require a realistic load test for network or concurrency paths, with bounds such as latency or resource use.
